Pop!_OS — Catppuccin Mocha Mauve

2026-07-11

A cohesive Catppuccin Mocha Mauve rice on Pop!_OS featuring a translucent Polybar top bar, Conky desktop widgets, patched GNOME Shell CSS for panel transparency, and a Makoto Shinkai-inspired cityscape wallpaper.

OSPop!_OS 22.04 LTS
ShellGNOME Shell 42.9 + Cosmic Desktop
Resolution2560×1600
GPUAMD Radeon
ThemeCatppuccin Mocha Mauve Standard + default
IconsPapirus-Dark
CursorBibata Modern Ice
TerminalAlacritty + GNOME Terminal
FontJetBrains Mono Nerd Font Mono
WallpaperMakoto Shinkai dusk cityscape with grid overlay + vignette
PromptStarship (custom mauve ╰─❯ config)
LauncherRofi with custom Catppuccin theme

What Makes This Rice

  • Translucent panel (~78% opacity) with custom CSS patching
  • Polybar top bar with CPU, RAM, network, battery monitoring
  • Dual-layer desktop widgets via Conky
  • Full Catppuccin Mauve palette across every component
  • Alacritty terminal with blur and btop system monitor
